suggestions.topic: EIP-7610 removal from Glamsterdam - ACDE decision outcome
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #92 reached consensus to remove EIP-7610 but deferred formal decision to ACDE (~1.5 weeks from Aug 17). Need to confirm ACDE outcome and update Glamsterdam scope.

suggestions.topic: Devnet-8 → Gloas fork transition results and SSZ performance
suggestions.rationale: Devnet-8 fork transition was scheduled for ~2 days 17 hours after Aug 17. Critical to review transition success, SSZ encoding performance at fork boundary, and any issues encountered.
Toni Wahrstätter was tasked with rerunning the 9.5 MB payload flooding attack on devnet-8 after Lighthouse's duplicate envelope fix. Status update needed to confirm mitigation effectiveness.

suggestions.topic: Circuit breaker implementation status across CL clients
suggestions.rationale: Teku implemented circuit breaker for devnet-8, Nimbus is porting Fusaka design, but Lighthouse status was unknown as of ACDT #91. Need comprehensive status update before testnet launch.
Devnet-8 is the first public-facing testnet with finalized repricing. Review stability, client participation, and any blockers before broader testnet announcements.
ACDT #91 discussed bumping default gas limit to 200M at Glamsterdam fork but hit dual-flag complexity concerns. Barnabas was to draft alternative proposal; status needed.

suggestions.topic: Attestation deadline 2s lowering - post-fork data collection plan
suggestions.rationale: Decision made to keep 3s for Glamsterdam, defer 2s lowering post-fork via client release. EthPandaOps was to gather block-propagation/state-transition timing data post-fork; establish timeline.

suggestions.topic: Devnet-9 chaos testing scope and timeline
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #88 mentioned devnet-9 as non-finality/chaos-focused devnet within ~1 month of late July. Update needed on whether this is still planned post-devnet-8 stabilization.
